note: Owner's rules from 18 Nov 2026. Loss limit: a close 20% or more below average cost makes a holding a loser (early warning at 10%). Trailing: once a holding's peak close was 20% or more above cost, a close 15% or more below that peak flags it for a sell-part review. Applies to all holdings, including the six old losers. Before calling a flag, check volume, dividend dates and whether the close is live or official. Selling fees about 1.8-2%; buying back costs about the same, so a buy-back needs a fall of more than about 4%.
early_warning_note: Traffic light, added 18 Nov at the owner's request. red = a rule fired; amber = a tolerance signal (-10% on cost, 10% from peak when trailing is active, or within 5% of the trigger) plus at least one general sign (fall on 2x volume in the last 5 days, close below the 20-day average, a -9% day in the last 10, 3 falls in a row); watch = tolerance signal only; note = general sign only; green = none.
take_profit_note: Added 18 Nov at the owner's request (sell into strength). Targets: at +50% sell 25% of the holding, at +100% another 25%. Recover cost: once up 100%, sell enough units to get back everything paid and keep the rest. Size cap: no holding above 15% of the portfolio. Sells recorded in transactions.json after 18 Nov count as targets taken / cost returned.
